# if

Run an indented block when a condition is true.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `block.if` |
| Origin | DCode |
| Category | Blocks |
| Family | Conditional |
| Monaco kind | `block` |
| Format | `if <condition>:` |
| Valid contexts | `executable` |
| Autocomplete | `if condition:<br>    -- body<br>` |

## Transformation

if <condition> then ... end

## Example

```lua
if condition:
    -- body
```
